policy.availability: Archived issue-day delivery prices assumed available by 09:50 Copenhagen; historical publication/revision vintages are unavailable. Candidate parameters were selected after many evaluated dates; entire run is retrospective, not an untouched test.
policy.evaluation_policy: All target dates already inspected. No outer outcome may select alpha, gate policy or candidate. Gate and calibration updates may use earlier outer outcomes only on declared weekly origins.

excluded.fundamentals: No verified pre-cutoff historical load/wind/solar forecast vintages supplied; no realized target-day inputs substituted
excluded.live_operations: Historical replay cannot establish on-time operation; tasks remain disabled
excluded.trading_pnl: No specified actionable strategy, volumes, execution prices or costs; MAE is not P&L

inner_validation.selection: lowest pooled chronological OOF MAE; freeze alpha before outer period

intervals.raw_lightgbm: 160 iterations, default frozen quantile settings, 28-day refit anchored 2026-11-20

policy.residual_model: Ridge predicts actual minus previous-day price using common 210 features
policy.training: expanding labels strictly before origin; pipeline fitted per origin
